description: A single-select list with built-in action dispatch. On first valid selection, it writes selection data and sends an action with selectedValue and selectedIndex injected into context.

selection.description: Single-select value container. Although this is an array, only the first valid value is used for rendering.

path.description: A relative or absolute path in the data model.

action.description: Action emitted on first valid selection. Automatically enriched with selectedValue and selectedIndex.

context.description: A list of name-value pairs to be sent with the action to include data associated with the action, e.g. values that are submitted.

path.description: A path in the data model which should be bound to an input element, e.g. a string reference for a text field, or number reference for a slider.

literalString.description: A literal string relevant to the action

literalNumber.description: A literal number relevant to the action

literalBoolean.description: A literal boolean relevant to the action

items.description: Selectable list items rendered as capsule containers.

child.description: ID of the child component rendered in this item.

title: ActionSelectionList
